title: design-qa reviewer annotations
description: <report dir>/annotations.json: the issues a person marked on the report's captures in report.html because the pass missed them. Written only by scripts/apply-decisions.mjs from the decisions document (never by hand, never by the agent); read by scripts/build-report.mjs, which makes each one a finding once the agent has investigated it and filed it in findings.json ({ "annotation": "AN-001", "ledger", "region", "expected", "actual", "fix" }). Only a person adds or dismisses an annotation. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (unique ids, no annotation recorded twice: the same state, side, box and note) are checked by scripts/lib/annotations.mjs.

version.description: Format version. A higher version is a newer format: update the design-qa skill.

annotations.description: In the order they were recorded; ids are never reused.

id.description: AN-001, AN-002 …, given by apply-decisions.mjs in the order the annotations were recorded.

state.description: The state of the report it was drawn on (stateMatrix[].state), e.g. "with-data" or "cart/empty".

side.description: The image the reviewer marked: the app capture or the design.

box.description: The box the reviewer drew, in that image's pixels: whole numbers, starting inside the image, at least 8×8.

severity.description: The severity the reviewer gave; the finding keeps it (the agent may only mark a verified fix PASS).

note.description: The reviewer's description of the issue, trimmed. The finding's title defaults to its first line.

decision.description: Fix now or later, as the reviewer chose. A BLOCKER is always fix-now.

by.description: Who added it (the decisions document's decidedBy when the annotation names nobody).

date.description: When it was added (the decisions document's decidedAt when the annotation has no date).

source.description: Where it came from: the review in report.html.
